decision: The frozen nonlinear learner materially improves common-five but collapses union and leader-removal despite very high in-training rank correlations. Direct replacement of the time-comparable campaign ownership score with learned 60-session predictions is economically harmful in broad universes. Do not tune HGB defaults, horizon, feature subsets or score transforms.
research_boundary: Short-horizon linear expectation/rank learners and this long-horizon nonlinear score replacement have all failed to beat the campaign-peak champion. Further learner tuning is not the next direction.
next_direction: Preserve the campaign-peak discovery/ownership path and test a structurally different portfolio-construction rule that changes capital concentration among already-selected opportunities rather than changing alpha identity or lifecycle.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed causal tests, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
